rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Sensact is a Supabase-hosted remote MCP device platform that enables LLM clients like Claude to discover and invoke capabilities on user-owned devices. It provides OAuth 2.1 authorization through Supabase Auth and uses Postgres with Realtime for the control plane. Current capabilities include camera capture, contact lookup, and screen capture through one-shot device capability invocation.
